entries.columnsContract: `deregistration_id PK, shelf_id FK, state(active|committed), phase(waiting_responsibility|freezing_manifest|verifying|ready_to_commit|attention_required|completed), manifest_revision NULL, release_manifest_digest NULL, control_revision_set_digest NULL, entry_count, member_count, page_count, blocking_reason NULL, created_at_ms, committed_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(shelf_id)`；Manifest列在Intent Admission时为NULL/0，freeze后以CAS整体更新；每个Shelf最多一个Deregistration；Supporting Work通过Foundation反向关联；不得引用Deletion Capability

entries.columnsContract: `deregistration_id FK, manifest_revision, member_ordinal, page_ordinal, page_member_ordinal, shelf_entry_id FK, inventory_revision, inventory_member_ordinal, member_kind(controlled_material|reference_evidence), material_key, physical_identity_schema_ref, physical_identity_json, physical_identity_digest, reference_evidence_digest NULL, control_revision NULL, control_projection_digest NULL, member_digest, release_result NULL, committed_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(deregistration_id,manifest_revision,member_ordinal)`；每页最多100项；identity JSON上限`4 KiB`；terminal commit只写controlled_material的release_result/committed_at_ms，旧revision仍作为历史成员清单保留；reference_evidence的Control列和release_result必须为NULL

entries.columnsContract: `receipt_id PK, deregistration_id FK, shelf_id FK, released_control_set_digest, terminal_fact_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(deregistration_id)`；与Shelf administrative terminal commit同事务成立

entries.columnsContract: `perception_source_id PK, source_kind, integration_id, status, config_revision, current_cursor_revision NULL, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `current_cursor_revision IS NULL`表示尚无cursor row；`FOREIGN KEY(perception_source_id,current_cursor_revision) REFERENCES perception_source_cursors(perception_source_id,revision)`，SQLite以NULL跳过尚不存在的optional pointer校验；`INDEX(status,source_kind,perception_source_id)`；Integration ID为opaque platform reference

entries.columnsContract: `perception_acquisition_id PK, perception_source_id FK, source_config_revision, scope_schema_ref, scope_json, scope_digest, initial_cursor_revision, initial_cursor_value, state(active|completed|failed), created_at_ms, terminal_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: 一次Acquisition只属于一个Source/config revision；Scope JSON上限`16 KiB`；`UNIQUE(perception_source_id) WHERE state='active'`；`initial_cursor_revision=0`只是“创建时不存在cursor row”的逻辑CAS sentinel，不是FK pointer；Process历史不覆盖

entries.columnsContract: `perception_source_id FK, revision, perception_acquisition_id FK, cursor_in, cursor_out, observation_page_digest, has_more, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(perception_source_id,revision)`；revision从1递增且不重置；Source current pointer显式复合FK引用；仅Source从未同步时expected revision为0，配置/scope不兼容的后续Acquisition可令`cursor_in=null`但仍CAS当前非零revision；不覆盖历史

entries.columnsContract: `acquisition_commit_receipt_id PK, perception_acquisition_id FK, perception_source_id FK, page_ordinal, expected_cursor_revision, committed_cursor_revision, observation_page_digest, commit_marker, result_schema_ref, result_json, result_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(perception_acquisition_id,page_ordinal)`、`UNIQUE(commit_marker)`；Result JSON上限`64 KiB`且保存不含自digest字段的原始`perceptionIds/insertedCount/duplicateCount` typed result，`result_digest=SHA-256(JCS(result_json))`并与Event Result相同；与Record、Relation、cursor head、marker、Event Result和Outbox同事务

entries.columnsContract: `perception_id PK, perception_source_id FK, perception_acquisition_id FK, acquisition_commit_receipt_id FK, record_kind(observation|correction|retraction), source_kind, source_record_key, source_record_revision, source_record_digest, normalization_rule_ref, rating, watched_state, observed_title, provenance_ref, provenance_digest, record_digest, observed_at_ms, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: immutable；`record_digest`覆盖Record标量与按键排序的Identity Anchor set；`UNIQUE(perception_source_id,source_record_key,source_record_revision,source_record_digest)`；Canonical rating非空时`CHECK integer 1..5`且`0`禁止，`watched_state`只允许`NULL|0|1`；CommitParticipant要求correction/retraction在同页各有匹配的outgoing `supersedes/retracts` relation；`INDEX(source_kind,source_record_key,committed_at_ms)`
`PK(perception_id,anchor_kind,anchor_value)`；结构化Anchor不可退化为字符串数组；`INDEX(anchor_kind,anchor_value)`

entries.columnsContract: `relation_id PK, relation_kind(duplicate_of|supersedes|retracts), source_perception_id FK, target_perception_id FK, rule_revision, evidence_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: immutable；source不得等于target；`UNIQUE(relation_kind,source_perception_id,target_perception_id)`；`duplicate_of`使用规范化pair，`supersedes|retracts`保持方向性

entries.columnsContract: `resolution_id PK, query_contract, query_schema_ref, query_input_digest, fact_kind, revision, record_set_digest, rule_revision, rule_digest, result_kind, winning_perception_id NULL, reason_code NULL, result_schema_ref, result_json, result_digest, resolved_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(query_contract,query_input_digest,revision,resolution_id)`供head精确复合FK；`winning_perception_id`显式FK；found必须有winner且reason为NULL，not_found必须无winner并具有`no_matching_record|requested_fact_absent|strongest_value_conflict`之一；`result_json`保存完整typed `PerceptionResolutionRevision`且≤`16 KiB`，digest使用统一JCS basis；current pointer/index按query digest

`PK(query_contract,query_input_digest)`；四列显式复合FK引用同一`perception_resolution_revisions(query_contract,query_input_digest,revision,resolution_id)`；head CAS与新revision/typed result在同一Resolution Commit事务；Resolution Facade只读head，不在热路径计算`MAX(revision)`

entries.columnsContract: `person_id PK, status(active|merged), current_revision, current_preference_revision NULL, current_reference_revision NULL, current_reference_projection_revision, current_reference_projection_digest, created_at_ms, terminal_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `current_revision`显式复合FK引用`people_person_revisions`；nullable Preference/Reference pointer分别显式复合FK引用对应revision表；`current_reference_revision IS NULL`表示尚无Reference revision，Commit逻辑expected `0`映射为“期望不存在”而不是存储revision 0；两个Projection checkpoint字段均`NOT NULL`，`CHECK(current_reference_projection_revision>=1)`且digest为64位lowercase hex；Person成立时以revision `1`和无Reference语义payload的digest初始化；与child表的循环FK均`DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED`；`INDEX(status,person_id)`
